_comment: The RAM-resident sound driver ($D500-$DE66), unpacked from bank 5 at boot (loader $01F1 / $10A4) and called with bank 7 mapped. Cells come from the oracle's write watch over all scenarios (tools/ram_patches.py); every cell is an operand or opcode byte of an executed instruction that the program rewrites. Re-run tools/ram_patches.py after adding scenarios.
